label: Hyde Park Village
header:
# Hyde Park Village municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 11; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 51(a)(1) and section 52: five trustees are elected (three for three-year terms, two for two-year terms)

Village of Hyde Park, 'A Summary of the May 5, 2026 Annual Village Meeting': Peter Gallo was elected Trustee for three years (ending 2029) and David Whitesell for the remaining one year of a three-year term (ending 2027); Article 4 elected a trustee for two years ending 2028 whose name the summary leaves blank

Village of Hyde Park, Board of Trustees minutes, May 7, 2026: the sitting trustees are Frederika French, Peter Gallo, Susan Trainor, and David Whitesell; Trainor was chosen Chair and Gallo Clerk of the Board
Village of Hyde Park, Board of Trustees minutes, October 1, 2026: the same four trustees sit (Trainor, Chair). The fifth charter seat is unfilled

Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 51(a)(2) and section 55: one President is elected for a one-year term; the President presides at Village meetings as Moderator, so no separate moderator post is created
Village of Hyde Park, 'A Summary of the May 5, 2026 Annual Village Meeting', Article 1: Susan Bartlett was elected Village President and Moderator for a term of one year

Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 51(a)(3) and section 54: three Bliss Fund trustees, one elected each year for a three-year term
Village of Hyde Park, 'A Summary of the May 5, 2026 Annual Village Meeting', Article 3: Gary Anderson was elected Trustee of the Bliss Library fund for three years (ending 2029)

Town of Hyde Park, official monthly newsletter (October-November 2025), Village update: 'Bliss Library Fund: Edward French, Jack Anderson, and Adam Lory'. Gary Anderson's 2026 election fills the seat that stood that year; if Jack Anderson is a distinct person, his is the seat Gary Anderson took

Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 71(a)(1) and section 72: the Village Clerk is appointed by the Board of Trustees for a one-year term
Village of Hyde Park, Board of Trustees minutes, May 7, 2026: Karen Wescom was appointed Village Clerk

Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 71(a)(2) and section 73: the Village Treasurer is appointed by the Board of Trustees for a one-year term
Village of Hyde Park, Board of Trustees minutes, May 7, 2026: Karen Wescom was appointed Village Treasurer

Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 51(a)(4) and section 53: three auditors are elected for three-year terms, one each year. Structure only: no official source names the current village auditors

sources.note: Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 71(a)(3): a Delinquent Tax Collector is appointed by the Board of Trustees. Structure only: the 2026 organizational minutes record no appointment to the office

Charter of the Village of Hyde Park, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 225 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): section 71(a)(4): a Constable is appointed by the Board of Trustees. Structure only: the 2026 organizational minutes record no appointment to the office
